description: This file defines a React functional component called ChangeEditorButton, which provides a button to change the note editor type within a web application. It manages UI state, handles user interactions, and interacts with application services like keyboard shortcuts and icon utilities.

methods.name: ChangeEditorButton
methods.description: React functional component for rendering a button that toggles a menu to change the editor type of a note.

methods.name: toggleMenu
methods.description: Asynchronous callback to toggle the visibility of the change editor menu, optionally executing preprocessing before opening.

methods.name: disableClickOutside
methods.description: Sets state to disable click outside detection on the popover.
